Package org.tasktide.core.repository

Class JsonRepository<T extends TaskTideModel<T>>

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.core.repository.JsonRepository<T>
Type Parameters:
T - of TaskTideModel-WorkItem,Step,Workflow
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskTideRepository<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
JsonJobEnvironmentRepository, JsonMetricProfileRepository, JsonStepRepository, JsonWorkflowRepository, JsonWorkItemRepository
public abstract class JsonRepository<T extends TaskTideModel<T>> extends Object implements TaskTideRepository<T>
Class to support file backend in compressed json format. All linear operations
